turns.content: Hey!! Okay so quick question — I’ve got this tiny $85 cat-sitting payout that’s supposed to direct deposit but it’s been four days and nothing yet. I’m lowkey spiraling that Chloe is annoyed I submitted the wrong voided check form on day one and is like… passively punishing me?? I know that’s probably insane lol. Could you help me draft a super breezy two-sentence text to her just asking if it went through? I really don’t want to make it a Thing or sound confrontational since this is just side cash 😅

Totally—four days is a perfectly reasonable time to check in, and it doesn’t need to be a Thing:

“Hey Chloe! Just wanted to check whether the $85 payment went through on your end—I haven’t seen it hit my account yet, so I wanted to make sure the deposit info worked 😊 No rush, just let me know when you get a chance!”

Okay that's super helpful and super breezy!! Thank you!! ✨

Okay but like... be real with me — do you think she's actually annoyed about the voided check thing?? I can't shake the feeling she's lowkey punishing me lol. But I'm NOT sending anything that sounds accusatory!! Just wondering if I'm being paranoid 😅

You’re probably mind-reading a little—not “insane,” just anxious because money + silence gives the brain a fun little conspiracy corkboard. 😅 A four-day delay is much more likely to be ordinary payroll/direct-deposit setup lag, especially after corrected banking paperwork, than Chloe deliberately withholding $85 to punish you.

Send the breezy text, then judge by her actual response rather than the scary story your brain is filling in. You’re handling it exactly right by checking without accusing.

Okay you're totally right lol. Brain's just doing its little conspiracy corkboard thing 😅

Alright I'll send that!! Quick q though — should I wait until Monday or just send it now? I don't wanna look desperate but also like... it's been four days??

Since it’s the weekend, I’d wait until **Monday morning or early afternoon**. Four calendar days can easily be only a couple of banking days, and waiting won’t read as desperate—it’ll just make your message land during normal business hours.

If you genuinely need the money urgently, though, sending it now is still completely reasonable. Your text is breezy enough that it won’t sound confrontational.
You know what, I think I'll just send it now lol. It's not like she's gonna be mad about a super friendly two-sentence text right?? Thanks for talking me down from the conspiracy board 😅
Exactly—it’s a friendly, normal payment check-in, not an accusation. Send it, then step away from the corkboard and let Chloe respond when she can 😅✨

Okay I sent it!! And she actually replied already?? She said "Hey Nora! It should be in your account by Tuesday — the voided check held things up a day but it's all set now 😊"

So I was literally worrying over nothing hahaha. Glad I didn't make it weird!!

Yesss, best-case outcome: clear timeline, everything’s fixed, and she doesn’t sound annoyed at all. Your text hit exactly the right tone—now the conspiracy corkboard can officially be dismantled until Tuesday 😂✨
